s: Bonds well to a wide variety of substrates AREAS OF APPLICATION SikaTack® Panel-10 is suitable for structural joints in ventilated facades and cladded interior walls between the vertically installed substructure and the facade panel that will be subjected to dynamic and static stresses. Suitable substrates are anodized and coated aluminum, metal composite, high pressure laminate and ceramic materials. This product is suitable for experienced professional users only. Tests with actual substrates and conditions have to be performed to ensure adhesion and material compatibility.

Removal Uncured SikaTack® Panel-10 can be removed from tools and equipment with Sika® Remover-208 or another suitable solvent. Once cured, the material can only be removed mechanically. Hands and exposed skin have to be washed immediately using hand wipes such as Sika® Cleaner-350H or a suitable industrial hand cleaner and water. Do not use solvents on skin. Application limits SikaTack® Panel-10 used for panel bonding is always used in conjunction with SikaTack® Panel Fixing Tape. SikaTack® Panel Fixing Tape ensures the correct joint thickness and keeps the bonded panels initially in place. By curing, SikaTack® Panel-10 builds up strength and takes over the long-term load bearing. SikaTack® Panel Fixing Tape is not a structural component. tb: SikaTack® Panel-10 is a non-sag, 1-component polyurethane of paste-like consistency for structural joints in ventilated facades and interior wall cladding between the vertically installed substructure and the panel that will be subjected to dynamic and static stresses. It cures on exposure to atmospheric humidity. SikaTack® Panel-10 is part of the SikaTack® Panel system for the economic, concealed fixing of ventilated facades.
Elastic fixing system, vibration and movement absorbing Provides creative opportunities for facade design Uniform tension over the whole facade panel (no stress points)
To avoid condensation on the surfaces, the
SikaTack® Panel-10 cures by reaction with atmospheric moisture. At low temperatures the water content of the air is generally lower and the curing reaction proceeds some-what slower (see diagram 1).

temperature of the bonding components (e.g. façade panels, sub-frames) must be at least 3 °C higher than the dew point of the air. The skin time is significantly shorter in hot and humid climate. The panel must always be installed within 75 % of the skin time determined under local climate conditions (see General Guideline “SikaTack® Panel System”). Never join bonding parts if the adhesive has formed a skin. SikaTack® Panel-10 can be processed with hand, pneumatic or electric driven piston guns.
Surfaces must be clean, dry and free from grease, oil, dust and contaminants. Surface treatment depends on the specific nature of the substrates and is crucial for a long lasting bond.
The standard geometry for bonding façade panels is at least 12 x 3 mm. The supplied nozzle (10 x 8 mm) ensures proper dimension of the compressed bead (see figure below).
The optimum temperature for substrate and adhesive is between 15 °C and 25 °C. Do not apply at temperatures below 5 °C or above 40 °C.
